desc: Penny walks past Leonard, covering her face with her hand, irritated, holding a glass of wine, while Leonard stands in the living room.
Penny, with messy hair, puts her hand on Leonard's right shoulder and pushes him softly.
Penny puts her wine glass on the table and gets down on one knee in front of Leonard.
Leonard, in a brown jacket, turns away and rubs his eye with his hand.
Penny happily jumps toward Leonard on the sofa to give him a hug.
Leonard turns around while walking down the stairs, and extends his arm and hand towards Sheldon behind him.
Sheldon stumbles on the stairs, flailing as he searches for footing, when Leonard suddenly stops him.
Sad Sheldon sits down on the stairs, folds his hands on his knees and looks at the floor.
Stuart is leaning on the cashier counter at his comic store, very bored, when he is startled by Bernadette coming into the store.
Bernadette takes a comic book out of her purse and shows Stuart.
Stuart dumps a whole shoe box full of prescription bottles on the counter in the comic book store, in front of Bernadette.
Amy is looking through a microscope when Howard and Raj walk into her lab.
Penny closes the door and runs down the stairs carrying a box, when she passes Sheldon and goes back to him.
Penny, running down the stairs with a box, touches Sheldon on the shoulder while he's sitting on the stairs.
Penny smacks her hand against her leg, while holding a box, and then Sheldon runs to her.
Penny, holds up a hanger with her small work uniform hanging from it, while leaning on the bar and talking on the phone.
Penny jumps into the driver's seat of the car Sheldon is waiting in and closes the door angrily.
Amy working on her computer at the lab, when Bert walks in.
Bernadette walks into comic book store with Stuart and is amazed when she looks around.
Stuart walks over to a man sitting in an orange chair, eating popcorn.
Sheldon and Penny are doing yoga together in a living room, both raise their hands up.
Leonard comes into the apartment while Penny and Sheldon are exercising in the living room.
Sheldon stands with one arm stretched straight up and the other arm down at his side, bending  his body backward, looking around uncomfortable.
Sheldon looks with grimace at Penny while holding a yoga pose.
Penny lowers her arms and turns her head to Sheldon, who is stopping, stretching his body.
Sheldon presses his palms together and bows, standing in socks on a blue mat in the living room.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, looks dirty at Penny, standing next to him, and shakes his head no.
Leonard grabs Penny by the arms and walks her back a few steps, while standing in the living room in front of Sheldon.
Bernadette, angry, enters the toy store and walks up to a man in a grey vest at the counter.
Bert pounds his left fist on the dashboard of a car.
A shot of a busy multi-lane highway with cars driving in both directions, trees lining the roadside.
